task.title: Ensuring the reason for separation (RFS) details are correct

step.cmd: In RCM, review block 16 of the ROE and determine if the RFS is one of the following:

ul.li: K - Other / Change of payroll frequency
K - Other / Requested by Employment Insurance

K - Other / Change of Service Provider
If yes, go to step 8.
If no , go to step 9.

step.cmd: In NWS, on the Resolve Issue tab of the ROE RFS Action WI, complete the Resolve Issue section as follows:

ul.li: Do the Reason for Separation details need to be modified?: Select Yes and then A - Shortage of work .

step.cmd: In RCM, review block 18 and the Additional information field of the ROE and determine if there are comments related to the RFS:
Determine if the ROE requires any of the following changes:

ul.li: If the ROE requires a change to A - Shortage of work or D - Illness or injury , go to step 11.
If the ROE requires other changes, note the changes required and go to step 12.
If the ROE does not require changes, go to step 13. Warning

step.cmd: In NWS, determine if there is a ROD on file for the period of employment indicating that the RFS is other than shortage of work or illness or injury (e.g. dismissal or suspension, leave of absence, voluntary leaving):
In NWS, on the Resolve Issue tab of the ROE RFS Action WI, complete the Resolve Issue section as follows:

ul.li: Do the Reason for Separation details need to be modified?: Select Yes and the applicable RFS changes required (as indicated in step 10).

step.cmd: In NWS, on the Resolve Issue tab of the ROE RFS Action WI, complete the Resolve Issue section as follows:

ul.li: Do the Reason for Separation details need to be modified?: Select No .
